plain: To swear off or give up something solemnly, often under oath.

webster.text: To renounce upon oath; to abandon; as to abjure allegiance to a prince.

example.quote: I, A.B., do swear that I do from my heart abhor, detest and abjure as impious and heretical this damnable doctrine and position, that princes excommunicated or deprived by the Pope or any authority of the see of Rome may be deposed or murdered by their subjects or any other whatsoever.
